title: Post-induction residual time: a novel sensing phenomenon during induced ventricular fibrillation in subcutaneous ICD recipients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Subcutaneous implantable cardioverter defibrillators (S-ICD) are extensively used in the primary and secondary prevention of sudden cardiac death. Ventricular fibrillation (VF) induction during implantation remains standard to confirm device functionality.

OBJECTIVE: To compare electrocardiographic (ECG) and technical variables between induced and spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias in S-ICD recipients.

METHODS: A retrospective observational study was performed on 10 consecutive patients with S-ICD. Variables included episode duration, sensing time, charge time, and shock impedance. For each patient, the implant induced VF episode was compared to at least one spontaneous event during follow-up.

RESULTS: The mean age was 36.4 years (range: 22-61); 2 patients were male. All patients received intermuscular S-ICD implants, with the lead placed in the left parasternal position in 7 patients and right parasternal in 3. Episode duration and sensing time were consistently shorter in spontaneous events, and shock impedance was lower. Charge time, however, was longer in spontaneous events (by 1.4 to 1.8 s).

CONCLUSIONS: In this case series, spontaneous ventricular arrhythmic events in S-ICD patients demonstrated shorter sensing and therapy delivery times compared with induced ventricular fibrillation episodes. A measurable Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) was identified in all induced episodes and was absent during spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias, suggesting that 50-Hz-induced VF may not fully reproduce spontaneous arrhythmic events from the perspective of device sensing performance. These findings support the hypothesis that part of the delay observed during implant testing may be related to the induction process itself rather than to the intrinsic sensing capabilities of the S-ICD. Further studies are warranted to confirm these observations and to evaluate alternative VF induction strategies in future device platforms. Future integration of S-ICD systems with leadless pacing technologies may provide alternative ventricular fibrillation induction strategies, including T-wave shock delivery during either sensed intrinsic rhythm or leadless-paced rhythm. Such approaches could potentially avoid the occurrence of Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) and may provide a model that more closely reproduces spontaneous ventricular fibrillation than current 50-Hz induction techniques.

AI.tldr: 在S-ICD患者中，诱发性室颤的感知与治疗时间较自发性室性心律失常事件更长，且诱发性事件存在可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），提示50Hz诱导技术可能无法完全模拟自发性心律失常。
AI.motivation: 皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）植入时常规通过50Hz诱导室颤以验证设备功能，但诱导性室颤是否真实反映自发性心律失常的感知性能尚不明确，既往缺乏直接比较两者电生理与技术参数的研究。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性研究，连续纳入10例接受S-ICD植入的患者。比较植入时诱发的室颤事件与随访中至少一次自发性室性心律失常事件，分析事件持续时间、感知时间、充电时间和除颤阻抗等变量。
AI.result: 患者平均年龄36.4岁（范围22-61），男性2例。所有患者均接受肌间S-ICD植入，7例导线置于左胸骨旁，3例置于右胸骨旁。自发性事件的事件持续时间和感知时间均 consistently 更短，除颤阻抗更低；但充电时间在自发性事件中更长（延长1.4-1.8秒）。所有诱发性事件中均识别出可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），而自发性室性心律失常中PRT缺失。
AI.conclusion: S-ICD患者中自发性室性心律失常事件的感知和治疗递送时间短于诱发性室颤，诱发性事件存在PRT，提示50Hz诱导的室颤可能无法完全模拟自发性心律失常的感知性能，植入测试中的部分延迟可能与诱导过程本身而非S-ICD内在感知能力相关。未来需进一步研究验证，并探索替代诱导策略（如无导线起搏技术）以减少PRT。

summary_zh:
背景：皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）广泛用于心脏性猝死的一级和二级预防。植入过程中诱颤以确认设备功能仍是标准做法。

目的：比较S-ICD患者中诱发性与自发性室性心律失常的心电图（ECG）及技术参数。

方法：对10例连续接受S-ICD的患者进行回顾性观察性研究。变量包括发作持续时间、感知时间、充电时间和除颤阻抗。对每例患者，将植入时诱发的室颤发作与随访期间至少一次自发性事件进行比较。

结果：平均年龄为36.4岁（范围：22-61）；2例患者为男性。所有患者均接受肌间S-ICD植入，其中7例导线置于左胸骨旁位置，3例置于右胸骨旁位置。自发性事件的发作持续时间和感知时间均 consistently 较短，除颤阻抗较低。然而，自发性事件的充电时间较长（延长1.4至1.8秒）。

结论：在本病例系列中，与诱发性室颤发作相比，S-ICD患者的自发性室性心律失常事件表现出更短的感知和治疗 delivery 时间。在所有诱发性发作中均识别出可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），而在自发性室性心律失常期间则不存在，这表明从设备感知性能的角度来看，50-Hz诱发的室颤可能无法完全再现自发性心律失常事件。这些发现支持以下假设：植入测试期间观察到的部分延迟可能与诱导过程本身有关，而非S-ICD的固有感知能力。需要进一步研究以确认这些观察结果，并在未来设备平台中评估替代性室颤诱导策略。未来S-ICD系统与无导线起搏技术的整合可能提供替代性室颤诱导策略，包括在感知到的自身心律或无导线起搏心律期间发放T波电击。此类方法可能避免诱导后残余时间（PRT）的发生，并可能提供比当前50-Hz诱导技术更接近再现自发性室颤的模型。

title: Clinical Characteristics and Transplacental Treatment of Fetal Ventricular Tachycardia: A Nationwide Survey in Japan.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Fetal ventricular tachycardia (VT) is an ultra-rare form of tachyarrhythmia, and no established management strategy currently exists.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to clarify the current diagnostic and management approaches for fetal VT.

METHODS: A nationwide survey of suspected fetal VT was conducted across 77 tertiary referral facilities in Japan between 2014 and 2023.

RESULTS: In total, 24 fetal VT cases from 18 facilities were analyzed. Twenty cases were diagnosed based on atrioventricular dissociation. Four were initially diagnosed as supraventricular tachycardia. VT occurred by 32 6/7 weeks of gestation in all nine long QT syndrome (LQTS) cases (LQT 2 in six, LQT 3 in two, and other in one), whereas 8/15 non-LQTS cases occurred at term. Eight of 20 cases managed as fetal VT, and three of four cases managed as fetal supraventricular tachycardia received fetal treatment. Fetal treatments were effective in 9/11 cases overall and in 8/9 LQTS cases. Side effects were observed in 6/11 cases; however, no serious adverse events occurred, except one case of lidocaine toxicity. After birth, LQTS cases were more likely to be refractory to treatment than non-LQT cases (8/9 vs. 6/14), requiring multidisciplinary management. Neurodevelopmental delay was more frequent in LQTS cases than in non-LQTS cases (6/9 vs. 2/14).

CONCLUSIONS: Transplacental treatment is highly recommended for preterm fetal VT. In particular, in cases of fetal VT diagnosed before 33 weeks of gestation, aggressive fetal treatment including magnesium sulfate and β-blockers should be considered with the possibility of LQT 2 or 3.

AI.tldr: 日本全国调查24例胎儿室速，LQTS相关者多在33周前发病且经胎盘治疗有效率高，但出生后更易耐药并伴神经发育延迟。
AI.motivation: 胎儿室性心动过速（VT）是极罕见的快速性心律失常，目前尚无公认的管理策略，诊断与治疗决策缺乏系统数据。
AI.method: 2014至2023年日本77家三级转诊中心全国性调查，纳入疑似胎儿VT病例，分析诊断依据、发病孕周、经胎盘治疗（药物种类、有效性及不良反应）及出生后结局；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 共18家机构24例胎儿VT。20例依据房室分离诊断，4例初诊为室上速。9例长QT综合征（LQTS）均在32 6/7周前发病（LQT2 6例、LQT3 2例、其他1例），非LQTS 15例中8例足月发病。20例按胎儿VT管理中的8例及4例按室上速管理中的3例接受胎儿治疗。总体治疗有效9/11例，LQTS病例有效8/9例。6/11例出现不良反应，除1例利多卡因毒性外无严重不良事件。出生后LQTS病例更易治疗耐药（8/9 vs 6/14），神经发育延迟更常见（6/9 vs 2/14）。
AI.conclusion: 对早产胎儿VT推荐经胎盘治疗；33周前诊断的胎儿VT应积极治疗（包括硫酸镁和β受体阻滞剂），并考虑LQT2或LQT3可能。LQTS相关胎儿VT出生后需多学科管理，耐药及神经发育延迟风险高。本研究为回顾性全国调查，样本量小，统计方法及置信区间未报告，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：胎儿室性心动过速（VT）是一种极其罕见的快速性心律失常，目前尚无公认的管理策略。

目的：本研究旨在阐明目前胎儿VT的诊断和管理方法。

方法：2014年至2023年间，在日本77家三级转诊机构开展了一项疑似胎儿VT的全国性调查。

结果：共分析了来自18家机构的24例胎儿VT病例。20例基于房室分离作出诊断。4例最初诊断为室上性心动过速。在所有9例长QT综合征（LQTS）病例中（LQT 2型6例，LQT 3型2例，其他1例），VT均发生在孕32 6/7周之前，而15例非LQTS病例中有8例发生在足月时。20例按胎儿VT管理的病例中有8例接受了胎儿治疗，4例按胎儿室上性心动过速管理的病例中有3例接受了胎儿治疗。胎儿治疗总体在9/11例中有效，在LQTS病例中8/9例有效。6/11例观察到副作用；然而，除1例利多卡因毒性外，未发生严重不良事件。出生后，LQTS病例比非LQT病例更可能对治疗无效（8/9 vs. 6/14），需要多学科管理。LQTS病例的神经发育迟缓比非LQTS病例更常见（6/9 vs. 2/14）。

结论：强烈推荐对早产胎儿VT进行经胎盘治疗。特别是对于孕33周前诊断的胎儿VT病例，应考虑包括硫酸镁和β受体阻滞剂在内的积极胎儿治疗，并考虑到LQT 2或3的可能性。

title: Identifying the High-Risk Arrhythmic Mitral Valve Prolapse Phenotype by Imaging
summary: Within arrhythmogenic mitral valve prolapse (AMVP), a distinct subset of mitral valve prolapse (MVP), there is a small group that carries a higher risk of malignant ventricular arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death called malignant MVP. The malignant MVP phenotype is over-represented in young women with unexplained sudden cardiac death on autopsy. AMVP is defined by myxomatous, often bileaflet MVP with mitral annular disjunction, abnormal valvular-myocardial mechanics, complex ventricular ectopy, and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia. Excessive mechanical force from systolic annular expansion, papillary muscle traction, and basal inferolateral "curling" promotes focal replacement and diffuse interstitial fibrosis, creating an arrhythmogenic substrate. Premature ventricular contractions act as triggers, whereas autonomic modulation influences the timing of ventricular arrhythmia initiation and progression to ventricular fibrillation or sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Baseline evaluation with an electrocardiogram and transthoracic echocardiography is necessary to identify AMVP, exclude severe mitral regurgitation, and identify high-risk markers. If no premature ventricular contractions are found on a resting electrocardiogram, exercise stress testing and extended rhythm monitoring can help bring out ventricular premature contractions, which are triggers of ventricular arrhythmias. Cardiac magnetic resonance provides incremental prognostic value with late gadolinium enhancement reflecting replacement fibrosis and T1 mapping identifying diffuse fibrosis, even in those with no late gadolinium enhancement. Machine-learning analysis may further refine risk stratification by integrating high-risk features such as mitral annular disjunction, fibrosis extent, and location that outperform symptom-based assessment. As transcatheter and surgical mitral interventions expand, accurate phenotyping of AMVP is increasingly important, as hemodynamic correction of mitral regurgitation alone does not eliminate the underlying arrhythmogenic substrate. Comprehensive multimodality imaging and integrated rhythm assessment are therefore central to individualized risk stratification and management in this vulnerable population.

AI.tldr: 综述指出，致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）中的恶性表型多见于年轻女性，需结合超声、心脏磁共振及节律监测识别高危特征以进行风险分层。
AI.motivation: AMVP是二尖瓣脱垂中一个独特的亚群，其中一小部分患者具有较高的恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死风险，称为恶性MVP。该表型在年轻女性不明原因猝死的尸检中占比过高，但既往基于症状的评估不足以识别高危患者，且经导管或外科二尖瓣干预仅纠正反流不能消除致心律失常基质，因此需要更精准的表型识别和风险分层。
AI.method: 本文为综述，系统总结了AMVP的定义、病理生理机制、影像学评估和风险管理策略。AMVP定义为黏液样、常为双叶脱垂伴二尖瓣环分离、异常瓣膜-心肌力学、复杂室性早搏和非持续性室性心动过速。评估手段包括基线心电图和经胸超声心动图识别AMVP及高危标志、运动负荷试验和延长节律监测以诱发室早、心脏磁共振通过晚期钆增强评估替代性纤维化及T1 mapping识别弥漫性纤维化，以及机器学习整合高危特征进行风险分层。摘要未报告具体样本量或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据或统计结果。综述指出，心脏磁共振的晚期钆增强反映替代性纤维化，T1 mapping可识别弥漫性纤维化（即使无晚期钆增强），提供增量预后价值；机器学习分析整合二尖瓣环分离、纤维化范围和位置等高危特征，可能优于基于症状的评估。室早是触发因素，自主神经调节影响室性心律失常的启动时机及向室颤或持续性单形性室速的进展。
AI.conclusion: 综合多模态影像和整合节律评估是AMVP患者个体化风险分层和管理的核心。临床意义在于：对年轻女性MVP患者应积极筛查高危影像和节律标志，即使无晚期钆增强也需评估弥漫纤维化；二尖瓣干预不能替代心律失常风险管理。局限性为本文为综述，缺乏原始数据，且风险分层策略仍需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 在致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）——二尖瓣脱垂（MVP）的一个独特亚群——中，存在一小部分携带较高恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死风险的患者，称为恶性MVP。恶性MVP表型在尸检时发现不明原因心源性猝死的年轻女性中过度代表。AMVP的定义为黏液样、常为双叶的MVP伴二尖瓣环分离、瓣膜-心肌力学异常、复杂室性异位搏动和非持续性室性心动过速。收缩期瓣环扩张、乳头肌牵拉和基底下侧壁“卷曲”产生的过度机械力促进局灶性替代和弥漫性间质纤维化，形成致心律失常基质。室性早搏作为触发因素，而自主神经调节影响室性心律失常起始和进展为心室颤动或持续性单形性室性心动过速的时机。基线的电图和经胸超声心动图评估对于识别AMVP、排除严重二尖瓣反流和识别高风险标志物是必要的。如果在静息电图上未发现室性早搏，运动负荷试验和延长节律监测可以帮助诱发出室性早搏，这些是室性心律失常的触发因素。心脏磁共振提供增量预后价值，晚期钆增强反映替代纤维化，T1标测识别弥漫性纤维化，即使在无晚期钆增强的患者中也是如此。机器学习分析可能通过整合高风险特征如二尖瓣环分离、纤维化范围和位置来进一步细化风险分层，这些特征优于基于症状的评估。随着经导管和外科二尖瓣干预的扩展，AMVP的准确表型分析越来越重要，因为仅对二尖瓣反流进行血流动力学矫正并不能消除潜在的致心律失常基质。因此，综合多模态成像和整合节律评估对于这一脆弱人群的个体化风险分层和管理至关重要。

title: Multimodality Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in a Hypoplastic Right Ventricle After Glenn Palliation.
summary: Adults with single-ventricle physiology increasingly survive into adulthood and may develop complex ventricular arrhythmias. A 44-year-old man with severe right ventricular hypoplasia and previous bidirectional Glenn palliation presented with sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Transthoracic and intracardiac echocardiography, computed tomography, and high-density electroanatomic mapping were combined to reconstruct the right-sided anatomy and to characterize the arrhythmogenic substrate. Intracardiac echocardiographic contours were merged with the electroanatomic map to build the geometry of the rudimentary right ventricle, in which extensive low-voltage areas were identified, with the latest and most fragmented late potentials confined to the anterior right ventricular outflow tract. Programmed stimulation did not induce ventricular tachycardia; however, pace mapping within the late-potential region reproduced the clinical QRS morphology with a stimulus-to-QRS interval of 153 milliseconds. Ablation was therefore guided by substrate homogenization, and a postablation high-density remap confirmed abolition of all late potentials. A subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was implanted before discharge.

AI.tldr: 一例右心室发育不良且既往行双向Glenn术的成人患者，经多模态影像与高密度标测指导，以基质均质化消融成功治疗持续性单形性室速，术后晚电位消失并植入皮下ICD。
AI.motivation: 单心室生理成人患者存活至成年者增多，可发生复杂室性心律失常；此类患者右心结构严重异常，常规标测与消融策略缺乏报道，需探索多模态影像整合指导的个体化方案。
AI.method: 病例报告。44岁男性，重度右心室发育不良、既往双向Glenn姑息术后，表现为持续性单形性室速。联合经胸与心腔内超声、CT及高密度电解剖标测重建右心解剖并表征致心律失常基质；将心腔内超声轮廓与电解剖图融合构建残存右心室几何。行程序电刺激及起搏标测，以基质均质化为消融策略，术后高密度重标测验证晚电位是否消除。
AI.result: 残存右心室见广泛低电压区，最晚及最碎裂的晚电位局限于右心室流出道前部。程序电刺激未诱发室速；但在晚电位区域内起搏标测可复制临床QRS形态，刺激-QRS间期为153 ms。据此行基质均质化消融，术后高密度重标测证实所有晚电位均被消除。出院前植入皮下ICD。摘要未报告消融次数、手术时长及随访期心律失常复发数据。
AI.conclusion: 对于单心室生理合并复杂室速的成人患者，多模态影像融合高密度标测可精准刻画残存右心室基质，起搏标测复制临床QRS可定位关键靶区，基质均质化消融可消除晚电位；皮下ICD可作为此类解剖异常患者的器械治疗选择。本结果为单例经验，疗效与安全性需更多病例及随访验证。

summary_zh: 单心室生理的成人患者越来越多地存活至成年，并可能发生复杂的室性心律失常。一名44岁男性，患有重度右心室发育不良并既往接受过双向Glenn姑息手术，表现为持续性单形性室性心动过速。联合应用经胸和心腔内超声心动图、计算机断层扫描和高密度电解剖标测来重建右侧解剖结构并刻画致心律失常基质。将心腔内超声心动图轮廓与电解剖标测图融合，构建发育不良右心室的三维几何结构，在其中识别出广泛低电压区，最晚且最碎裂的晚电位局限于右心室流出道前部。程序刺激未诱发室性心动过速；然而，在晚电位区域内进行起搏标测可重现临床QRS形态，刺激至QRS间期为153毫秒。因此，消融以基质均质化为指导，消融后高密度再标测证实所有晚电位均被消除。出院前植入了皮下植入式心律转复除颤器。

title: Rapid Radiological Disappearance of Pancreatic Duct Stones Following Oral Trimethadione
summary: A 59-year-old man with chronic pancreatitis, surgically altered anatomy, and an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator presented with acute exacerbation caused by cast-like obstructive pancreatic duct stones. Endoscopic therapy was considered technically difficult, and extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy was avoided. While delayed surgical drainage was being considered, off-label oral trimethadione was started after institutional ethics approval. Computed tomography 2 weeks later showed disappearance of the stones and improvement of ductal dilatation. No adverse events occurred, and surgery was deferred. This case suggests that trimethadione may be a potential salvage option when standard interventions are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 一例合并ICD的慢性胰腺炎患者，口服三甲双酮2周后胰管结石影像学迅速消失，提示其或为无法行常规干预时的挽救选择。
AI.motivation: 慢性胰腺炎伴铸型梗阻性胰管结石在解剖结构改变（如术后）患者中处理困难，内镜治疗技术难度大，体外冲击波碎石在该例被回避，手术引流需延迟，标准干预不可行时缺乏替代方案，既往证据亦无三甲双酮用于此情形的报道。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（ACG Case Rep J）。对象为59岁男性，慢性胰腺炎、外科改变解剖结构并植入ICD，因铸型梗阻性胰管结石急性加重就诊。内镜治疗被认为技术困难，未行体外冲击波碎石；在考虑延迟手术引流期间，经机构伦理批准后超说明书口服三甲双酮。终点为影像学（CT）结石与胰管扩张变化及不良事件，随访2周复查CT。摘要未报告剂量与统计方法。
AI.result: 口服三甲双酮2周后CT显示胰管结石消失、胰管扩张改善；未发生不良事件，手术被推迟。摘要未报告具体剂量、结石大小及实验室指标。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，当内镜、体外冲击波碎石及手术等标准干预不可行时，三甲双酮可能作为挽救性口服选择；但仅为单例观察，缺乏对照与机制证据，不能据此改变临床实践，需进一步研究验证其疗效与安全性，尤其需关注合并ICD患者的用药风险。

summary_zh: 一名59岁男性，患有慢性胰腺炎、手术改变了解剖结构，并植入有植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD），因管型梗阻性胰管结石导致急性加重就诊。内镜治疗被认为技术困难，体外冲击波碎石被避免。在考虑延期手术引流期间，经机构伦理批准后开始超说明书口服三甲双酮。2周后计算机断层扫描显示结石消失、胰管扩张改善。未发生不良事件，手术被推迟。本病例提示，当标准干预不可行时，三甲双酮可能是一种潜在的挽救性选择。

title: Do pacemakers prolong the dying process in a palliative setting?-a retrospective matched cohort analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Clinicians caring for end-of-life patients regularly receive questions from patients and relatives about whether the pacemaker (PM) has to be deactivated. The possible life-prolonging effect of an active PM on the dying process of a palliative patient remains a scientific and clinical question in the literature and is a challenge for caregivers and patients in the end-of-life phase. This study analyzed whether there is a possible life-prolonging effect of an active PM in palliative patients.

METHODS: The time that 83 terminal palliative PM patients passed at a palliative care until death is compared with the time that 163 matched control terminal non-PM patients passed at the same palliative care unit (PCU). The non-PM patients are matched for age, gender, and underlying diseases.

RESULTS: The survival curves of PM and matched control non-PM patients were, for most of the time, exactly superimposed. Some PM patients died in the period 10-45 days after intake at the PCU a few days earlier than the control patients. This may be explained by their higher cardiovascular morbidity, more frequent previous cardiac surgery, more diabetes mellitus, and impaired kidney function.

CONCLUSIONS: There is no evidence that an active PM prolongs the dying process in terminal PCU patients; a few PM patients died even earlier than their matched control non-PM patients.

AI.tldr: 回顾性匹配队列显示，终末期姑息治疗患者中，未停用起搏器并未延长死亡过程，部分患者甚至比匹配对照更早死亡。
AI.motivation: 终末期患者及家属常询问是否需要关闭起搏器，但活跃起搏器是否延长姑息患者的死亡过程尚缺乏证据，给临床决策带来挑战。
AI.method: 回顾性匹配队列分析，纳入83例终末期起搏器患者与163例匹配的非起搏器对照，对照按年龄、性别和基础疾病匹配，比较两组在姑息治疗病房从入院至死亡的时间，采用生存曲线分析。
AI.result: 起搏器组与对照组的生存曲线大部分时间完全重叠；部分起搏器患者在入院后10-45天死亡，较对照早数天，可能与心血管合并症更多、既往心脏手术更频繁、糖尿病更多及肾功能受损有关。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 无证据表明活跃起搏器延长终末期姑息患者的死亡过程，少数起搏器患者甚至更早死亡；这为终末期起搏器管理提供了参考，但回顾性设计及未报告统计细节限制了结论强度。

summary_zh:
背景：照护临终患者的临床医生经常收到患者及其家属关于是否必须停用起搏器（PM）的询问。在文献中，有源PM对姑息治疗患者死亡过程可能存在的延长生命效应仍是一个科学和临床问题，也是临终阶段照护者和患者面临的挑战。本研究分析了有源PM在姑息治疗患者中是否存在可能的延长生命效应。

方法：比较了83例终末期姑息治疗PM患者在姑息治疗单元直至死亡所度过的时间与163例匹配的对照终末期非PM患者在同一姑息治疗单元（PCU）所度过的时间。非PM患者按年龄、性别和基础疾病进行匹配。

结果：PM患者与匹配的对照非PM患者的生存曲线在大部分时间完全重叠。部分PM患者在入住PCU后10-45天期间死亡，比对照患者早几天。这可能由其更高的心血管疾病发病率、更频繁的既往心脏手术、更多的糖尿病和肾功能受损来解释。

结论：没有证据表明有源PM会延长终末期PCU患者的死亡过程；少数PM患者甚至比其匹配的对照非PM患者死亡更早。

title: Eighteen Years of Complication-Free Survival Following Inadvertent Left Ventricular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD) Lead Placement via Atrial Septal Defect: A Case Report
summary: Implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) are recommended for primary or secondary prevention in multiple cardiac conditions.One of the recognised complications during implantation of cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) is inadvertent lead malposition in the left heart (ILMLH), which can lead to further thromboembolism and infective endocarditis.In this paper, we present a unique case of a patient who had an accidental ICD lead implanted into the left ventricle via an atrial septal defect (ASD).Evidence on the management of such a complication is rare.A watchful-wait approach with appropriate anticoagulation was adopted here, resulting in an uneventful 18year survival.We also navigate through the current evidence on the recognition and management of such cases.

AI.tldr: 一例经房间隔缺损误入左心室的ICD导线患者，采用抗凝观察策略后18年无并发症生存。
AI.motivation: 心脏植入式电子器械（CIED）植入时导线误入左心（ILMLH）是已知并发症，可导致血栓栓塞和感染性心内膜炎，但关于其管理策略的证据罕见。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者因意外经房间隔缺损（ASD）将ICD导线植入左心室，采用抗凝治疗的观察等待策略，随访18年。同时综述现有关于此类病例识别与管理的证据。
AI.result: 患者18年生存期间无并发症发生。摘要未报告具体抗凝方案、影像学随访细节及血栓栓塞或感染事件发生率。
AI.conclusion: 对于ICD导线误入左心且经ASD的病例，抗凝观察等待策略可能是一种可行的管理选择，但需个体化评估。本案例为罕见并发症的管理提供了长期随访证据，但受限于病例报告设计，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）被推荐用于多种心脏疾病的初级或二级预防。心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）植入过程中公认的并发症之一是导线意外误入左心（ILMLH），这可能导致进一步的血栓栓塞和感染性心内膜炎。在本文中，我们介绍一例独特的病例，患者通过房间隔缺损（ASD）意外将ICD导线植入左心室。关于此类并发症管理的证据罕见。此处采用了谨慎观察等待策略并给予适当的抗凝治疗，结果患者无事件生存18年。我们还梳理了当前关于此类病例识别和管理的证据。

title: Outcomes of leadless pacing with the Micra VR beyond 10 years.
Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure
summary: Background/objectives Heart failure (HF) is one of the leading causes of death and impairs quality of life worldwide. Systemic inflammation has been increasingly recognized as a major contributor to adverse outcomes in patients with heart failure. The Inflammatory Burden Index (IBI), a composite marker integrating C-reactive protein (CRP), neutrophils, and lymphocytes, may offer improved prognostic value over traditional inflammatory markers. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of IBI in predicting one-year mortality among patients undergoing Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT). Methods This retrospective observational study included 525 heart failure patients who received CRT between January 2020 and January 2024. Patients were grouped based on 1-year survival status. Continuous variables were compared using Student's t-test or Mann–Whitney U test based on normality assessment, and presented as mean ± SD or median [interquartile range, IQR]. To handle right-skewness and ensure linearity in the logit, inflammatory markers were logarithmically transformed [Log(IBI) and Log(CRP)]. Multivariable logistic regression models were constructed using a standardized baseline clinical model. Incremental prognostic value was evaluated using Integrated Discrimination Improvement (IDI), continuous Net Reclassification Improvement (NRI), and DeLong's test. Results Baseline CRP (median [IQR]: 20.90 [11.95–33.00] vs. 6.56 [3.37–13.80] mg/dL, p < 0.001) and IBI (median [IQR]: 81.15 [36.56–230.90] vs. 18.61 [7.76–44.46], p < 0.001) were significantly higher in non-survivors. In multivariable analysis, both Log(IBI) (OR: 1.983; 95% CI: 1.463–2.687; p < 0.001) and Log(CRP) (OR: 3.265; 95% CI: 2.278–4.678; p < 0.001) independently predicted 1-year mortality. Incorporating Log(IBI) or Log(CRP) significantly improved model discrimination over baseline clinical risk (AUC increased from 0.684 to 0.778 and 0.795, respectively; DeLong p < 0.001), yielding substantial IDI (0.0953 and 0.1118, p < 0.001) and continuous NRI (67.1% and 80.6%, p < 0.001) gains. Head-to-head comparison showed comparable discriminative performance between Log(IBI) and Log(CRP) models (DeLong p = 0.307). Conclusions Both Log(IBI) and Log(CRP) are independent predictors of 1-year mortality in HF patients undergoing CRT, offering comparable incremental prognostic utility over standard clinical risk factors. Incorporating these inflammatory biomarkers into routine risk stratification may refine the identification of high-risk candidates.

AI.tldr: 在525例接受CRT的心衰患者中，炎症负荷指数（IBI）和CRP均为1年死亡的独立预测因子，且较基线临床模型显著提升风险分层能力，但IBI与CRP预测效能相当。
AI.motivation: 心衰患者全身炎症与不良预后相关，但传统炎症标志物预后价值有限。IBI整合CRP、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞，可能优于单一指标，其在CRT人群中的预后意义尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性研究，纳入2020年1月至2024年1月接受CRT的525例心衰患者，按1年生存状态分组。炎症标志物经对数转换，采用多变量logistic回归分析，并通过IDI、连续NRI和DeLong检验评估增量预后价值。
AI.result: 非存活者基线CRP（中位数20.90 vs 6.56 mg/dL）和IBI（81.15 vs 18.61）均显著更高（均p<0.001）。多变量分析中，Log(IBI)（OR 1.983，95%CI 1.463–2.687）和Log(CRP)（OR 3.265，95%CI 2.278–4.678）均为1年死亡的独立预测因子（均p<0.001）。加入Log(IBI)或Log(CRP)后AUC从0.684分别升至0.778和0.795（DeLong p<0.001），IDI分别为0.0953和0.1118，连续NRI分别为67.1%和80.6%（均p<0.001）。两者预测效能无显著差异（DeLong p=0.307）。
AI.conclusion: IBI和CRP均可独立预测CRT患者1年死亡，并在标准临床风险因素基础上提供相当的增量预后价值。将炎症生物标志物纳入常规风险分层有助于识别高危患者，但IBI并未优于CRP，且回顾性设计需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景/目的：心力衰竭（HF）是全球范围内导致死亡和损害生活质量的主要原因之一。全身性炎症日益被认为是心力衰竭患者不良结局的重要因素。炎症负荷指数（IBI）是一种整合C反应蛋白（CRP）、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞的复合标志物，可能比传统炎症标志物提供更好的预后价值。本研究旨在评估IBI在接受心脏再同步治疗（CRT）的患者中预测一年死亡率的预后意义。

方法：这项回顾性观察性研究纳入了2020年1月至2024年1月期间接受CRT的525例心力衰竭患者。根据1年生存状态对患者进行分组。连续变量根据正态性评估采用Student's t检验或Mann–Whitney U检验进行比较，并以均值±标准差或中位数[四分位距，IQR]表示。为处理右偏态并确保logit中的线性，对炎症标志物进行对数转换[Log(IBI)和Log(CRP)]。使用标准化的基线临床模型构建多变量logistic回归模型。采用综合判别改善指数（IDI）、连续净重分类改善指数（NRI）和DeLong检验评估增量预后价值。

结果：基线CRP（中位数[IQR]：20.90 [11.95–33.00] vs. 6.56 [3.37–13.80] mg/dL，p < 0.001）和IBI（中位数[IQR]：81.15 [36.56–230.90] vs. 18.61 [7.76–44.46]，p < 0.001）在非存活者中显著更高。在多变量分析中，Log(IBI)（OR：1.983；95% CI：1.463–2.687；p < 0.001）和Log(CRP)（OR：3.265；95% CI：2.278–4.678；p < 0.001）均独立预测1年死亡率。纳入Log(IBI)或Log(CRP)显著改善了模型相对于基线临床风险的判别能力（AUC分别从0.684增至0.778和0.795；DeLong p < 0.001），并带来了显著的IDI（0.0953和0.1118，p < 0.001）和连续NRI（67.1%和80.6%，p < 0.001）增益。头对头比较显示Log(IBI)与Log(CRP)模型的判别性能相当（DeLong p = 0.307）。

结论：Log(IBI)和Log(CRP)均是接受CRT的心力衰竭患者1年死亡率的独立预测因子，在标准临床危险因素基础上提供相当的增量预后效用。将这些炎症生物标志物纳入常规风险分层可能有助于更精准地识别高危候选者。

title: Left bundle branch area pacing in dual-chamber pacemaker implantation: Procedural feasibility and electrical outcomes – Case series
summary: ABSTRACT Right ventricular pacing leads to nonphysiological ventricular activation and causes electrical dyssynchrony and adverse cardiac remodelling. Left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) responsible for physiological pacing strategy that preserves synchrony of ventricles by engaging the His–Purkinje system. The objective of the study was to evaluate the procedural feasibility and outcomes of LBBAP in patients undergoing dual chamber pacemaker implantation. In this single center, retrospective observational case series, seven patients undergoing dual chamber pacemaker implantation with LBBAP between January 2025 and January 2026 were included. Procedural success was defined as achievement of stable LBBAP with acceptable pacing parameters and significant QRS narrowing. Electrical parameters include pacing threshold, sensing amplitudes, and lead impedance, were assessed at implantation and prior to discharge. A total of seven patients underwent LBBAP. Successful LBBAP implantation was achieved in 6 of 7 patients (85.7%). The mean procedure time was 75 ± 15 min, with fluoroscopy time of 8 ± 3 min. LBBAP caused important QRS narrowing with stable lead parameters. Mean pacing thresholds of RA and RV were low, measuring 0.66 V in right atrium (RA) and 0.49 V in right ventricle (RV), showing stable lead activity with sufficient sensing and impedance values. No acute procedural complications, including lead dislodgement, cardiac perforation, or pneumothorax, were observed. LBBAP is a feasible and safe physiological pacing strategy in those patients undergoing dual chamber pacemaker implantation, demonstrating high procedural success and favourable short term electrical outcomes. Larger prospective studies are warranted to evaluate long term clinical benefits.

AI.tldr: 单中心7例双腔起搏器植入中行左束支区域起搏，6例（85.7%）成功，QRS明显变窄且起搏参数稳定，无急性并发症。
AI.motivation: 右心室起搏导致非生理性心室激动、电学不同步及不良心脏重构；左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）通过夺获希氏-浦肯野系统维持心室同步，但其在双腔起搏器植入中的可行性与电学结局证据有限。
AI.method: 单中心、回顾性观察性病例系列，纳入2025年1月至2026年1月行双腔起搏器植入并尝试LBBAP的7例患者。手术成功定义为获得稳定LBBAP、起搏参数可接受且QRS显著变窄；电学参数包括起搏阈值、感知幅度与导线阻抗，于植入时及出院前评估。摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 7例中6例（85.7%）成功完成LBBAP。平均手术时间75±15 min，透视时间8±3 min。LBBAP使QRS明显变窄，导线参数稳定；右心房与右心室平均起搏阈值分别为0.66 V与0.49 V，感知与阻抗值充足。未观察到导线脱位、心脏穿孔或气胸等急性手术并发症。摘要未报告QRS变窄的具体数值、随访时长及P值。
AI.conclusion: LBBAP在双腔起搏器植入中可行且安全，短期手术成功率高、电学结局良好，可作为生理性起搏策略；但样本量小、为回顾性单中心设计、缺乏长期临床结局，需更大规模前瞻性研究验证长期获益。

summary_zh: 摘要 右心室起搏导致非生理性心室激动，引起电不同步和不良心脏重构。左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）是一种生理性起搏策略，通过激动希氏-浦肯野系统来保持心室同步。本研究旨在评估接受双腔起搏器植入的患者中LBBAP的操作可行性和结局。在这项单中心、回顾性观察性病例系列中，纳入2025年1月至2026年1月期间接受双腔起搏器植入并实施LBBAP的7例患者。操作成功定义为实现稳定的LBBAP，起搏参数可接受且QRS波显著变窄。电学参数包括起搏阈值、感知振幅和导线阻抗，在植入时和出院前进行评估。共有7例患者接受了LBBAP。7例患者中有6例（85.7%）成功实现LBBAP植入。平均手术时间为75 ± 15 min，透视时间为8 ± 3 min。LBBAP引起QRS波显著变窄，导线参数稳定。RA和RV的平均起搏阈值较低，右心房（RA）为0.66 V，右心室（RV）为0.49 V，显示导线活动稳定，感知和阻抗值充足。未观察到急性操作并发症，包括导线脱位、心脏穿孔或气胸。LBBAP在接受双腔起搏器植入的患者中是一种可行且安全的生理性起搏策略，显示出较高的操作成功率和良好的短期电学结局。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来评估长期临床获益。

title: Axillary microaxial flow pump support for stepwise source control and bridge to durable left ventricular assist device therapy in cardiac device-related infective endocarditis.
summary: Cardiac device-related infective endocarditis complicated by end-stage heart failure poses a major therapeutic challenge because complete hardware removal is essential, whereas transvenous lead extraction may be poorly tolerated in patients with severe ventricular dysfunction and shock. We report a 53-year-old man with long-standing dilated cardiomyopathy and cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator infection who presented with methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia, pocket infection, respiratory failure, acute kidney injury, and a clinical presentation consistent with mixed septic-cardiogenic shock. Transthoracic echocardiography showed severe left ventricular dilatation and an ejection fraction of 10%. Because immediate extraction of a 17-year-old defibrillator lead was considered extremely high risk, an Impella 5.5 was implanted via the right subclavian artery, and surgical pocket drainage was performed as initial source control. After hemodynamic stabilization and reduction of vasoactive requirements, complete transvenous extraction of all leads was performed on hospital day 6 under ongoing Impella 5.5 support and cardiovascular surgical backup. During defibrillator lead traction, pulmonary artery pressure transiently decreased, but sustained systemic hemodynamic collapse did not occur. Following prolonged intravenous antibiotic therapy, blood cultures remained negative, renal function recovered sufficiently to discontinue continuous hemodiafiltration, and the patient was transferred to an advanced heart failure center. Durable left ventricular assist device implantation was subsequently performed successfully. This case suggests that axillary Impella 5.5 support may provide a stabilizing platform for staged source control, high-risk lead extraction, end-organ recovery, and bridge to durable mechanical circulatory support in carefully selected patients.

AI.tldr: 53岁扩张型心肌病合并CRT-D感染及混合性脓毒症-心源性休克患者，经腋动脉Impella 5.5支持完成分阶段感染源控制与高危导线拔除，最终成功桥接至持久性LVAD。
AI.motivation: 心脏装置相关感染性心内膜炎合并终末期心衰治疗矛盾突出：彻底移除装置是感染控制关键，但严重心室功能障碍和休克患者常难以耐受经静脉导线拔除，既往缺乏微轴流泵在此类高危场景中提供循环支持并实现分阶段处理的证据。
AI.method: 单病例报告。53岁男性，长期扩张型心肌病、CRT-D感染，表现为甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症、囊袋感染、呼吸衰竭、急性肾损伤及混合性脓毒症-心源性休克，TTE示左室严重扩大、LVEF 10%。因17年病史除颤导线立即拔除风险极高，先经右锁骨下动脉植入Impella 5.5并行囊袋外科引流作为初始感染源控制；血流动力学稳定后于住院第6天在Impella 5.5持续支持及心血管外科备台下完成全部导线经静脉拔除。摘要未报告统计方法。
AI.result: 除颤导线牵拉过程中肺动脉压一过性下降，但未发生持续性全身血流动力学崩溃。延长静脉抗生素疗程后血培养持续阴性，肾功能恢复至可停止连续性血液透析滤过，患者转至晚期心衰中心并成功植入持久性左室辅助装置。摘要未报告具体血流动力学数值、抗生素疗程及随访时间。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，对经严格筛选的心脏装置相关感染性心内膜炎合并心源性休克患者，腋动脉Impella 5.5支持可为分阶段感染源控制、高危导线拔除、终末器官恢复及桥接持久性机械循环支持提供稳定平台。结论受限于单例报告，尚需更多研究验证其可推广性。

summary_zh: 心脏装置相关感染性心内膜炎合并终末期心力衰竭构成重大治疗挑战，因为必须完全移除装置，而在严重心室功能障碍和休克患者中，经静脉导线拔除可能耐受性差。我们报告一例53岁男性，患有长期扩张型心肌病和心脏再同步治疗-除颤器感染，表现为甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症、囊袋感染、呼吸衰竭、急性肾损伤，以及符合混合性脓毒症-心源性休克的临床表现。经胸超声心动图显示严重左心室扩张，射血分数为10%。由于立即拔除一根已植入17年的除颤器导线被认为风险极高，通过右锁骨下动脉植入Impella 5.5，并进行手术囊袋引流作为初始感染源控制。在血流动力学稳定和血管活性药物需求减少后，于住院第6天在持续Impella 5.5支持和心血管外科后备下，完成所有导线的完全经静脉拔除。在除颤器导线牵引过程中，肺动脉压力短暂下降，但未发生持续性全身血流动力学崩溃。经过长期静脉抗生素治疗，血培养保持阴性，肾功能恢复至足以停止连续血液透析滤过，患者被转至晚期心力衰竭中心。随后成功进行了持久性左心室辅助装置植入。本病例提示，在精心选择的患者中，腋动脉Impella 5.5支持可能为分期感染源控制、高风险导线拔除、终末器官恢复和桥接至持久性机械循环支持提供稳定平台。

title: Differences in Tricuspid Valve Insufficiency, Mechanical Synchrony, and Cardiac Remodeling Between Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing and Right Ventricular Pacing.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac implantable electronic device-induced tricuspid regurgitation (CIED-induced TR) involves primary (lead-induced) and functional etiologies. The impact of left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) versus right ventricular pacing (RVP) on these mechanisms remains unclear.

OBJECTIVE: To compare the incidence and mechanisms of TR among pacing modalities, and evaluate the prognostic significance of these mechanisms.

METHODS: We analyzed 225 patients with first-time RV apical pacing (RVAP, n=97) or RV septal pacing (RVSP, n=78) using stylet-driven leads, and LBBAP (n=50) using lumenless leads. Echocardiography and electrocardiography were performed at baseline and 2 years post-implantation. Three-dimensional echocardiography assessed lead interference. Kaplan-Meier analysis compared event-free survival between lead-induced (LITR) and functional TR (FTR) groups. Cox regression identified predictors for adverse outcomes.

RESULTS: Despite a higher baseline heart failure burden than RVP (P< .001), LBBAP showed the lowest TR progression rate (20.0% vs RVAP 43.3% vs RVSP 35.9%, P=.020) over 25.8 months. Mechanistically, LBBAP shortened QRS duration (vs RVP widening, P< .001) and demonstrated less lead interference than RVAP (28.0% vs 50.5%, P= .009). Furthermore, LBBAP showed greater left-heart reverse remodeling and improvement in mitral regurgitation, while preserving right-heart structure and function better than RVP. Over 37.4 months, LITR showed worse outcomes than FTR (P= .03). LITR, pulmonary hypertension, reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, and elevated creatinine were independent predictors for adverse outcomes.

CONCLUSION: LBBAP was associated with less CIED-induced TR than RVP, likely through reduced mechanical interference, superior electrical synchrony, and favorable cardiac remodeling. Furthermore, LITR was associated with a worse prognosis than FTR.

AI.tldr: 在基线心衰负担更重的情况下，左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）2年内三尖瓣反流进展率仍低于右室心尖部或间隔部起搏（20.0% vs 43.3%/35.9%），且导线相关三尖瓣反流预后劣于功能性反流。
AI.motivation: 心脏植入式电子装置相关三尖瓣反流（CIED-induced TR）包括导线机械干扰所致的原发性（导线相关）反流和功能性反流两类，但LBBAP与右室起搏（RVP）对这两类机制的影响及各自预后意义尚不明确，临床缺乏起搏方式选择对三尖瓣反流影响的对比证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性分析225例首次植入起搏器患者，分为右室心尖部起搏（RVAP，n=97）、右室间隔部起搏（RVSP，n=78，均使用stylet驱动导线）和LBBAP（n=50，使用lumenless导线）三组。基线和植入后2年行超声心动图与心电图检查，三维超声评估导线干扰；主要比较三尖瓣反流进展率及机制，Kaplan-Meier分析比较导线相关TR（LITR）与功能性TR（FTR）的无事件生存，Cox回归筛选不良结局预测因素。
AI.result: 中位随访25.8个月，LBBAP组三尖瓣反流进展率最低（20.0% vs RVAP 43.3% vs RVSP 35.9%，P=0.020），尽管其基线心衰负担显著高于RVP组（P<0.001）。机制上，LBBAP缩短QRS时限而RVP延长QRS时限（P<0.001），且导线干扰率低于RVAP（28.0% vs 50.5%，P=0.009）；LBBAP左心逆重构及二尖瓣反流改善更明显，右心结构与功能保留也优于RVP。中位随访37.4个月，LITR组结局劣于FTR组（P=0.03）；LITR、肺动脉高压、LVEF降低和肌酐升高是不良结局的独立预测因素。
AI.conclusion: LBBAP较RVP可减少CIED相关三尖瓣反流，机制可能为导线机械干扰更少、电同步性更优及心脏重构更有利；导线相关TR预后差于功能性TR，提示应重视起搏导线所致三尖瓣反流的预防与随访。本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏植入式电子装置诱发的三尖瓣反流（CIED-induced TR）包括原发性（导线所致）和功能性病因。左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）与右心室起搏（RVP）对这些机制的影响尚不清楚。

目的：比较不同起搏方式之间三尖瓣反流（TR）的发生率和机制，并评估这些机制的预后意义。

方法：我们分析了225例首次接受右心室心尖部起搏（RVAP，n=97）或右心室间隔部起搏（RVSP，n=78）并使用 stylet 驱动导线的患者，以及接受 LBBAP（n=50）并使用无腔导线（lumenless leads）的患者。在基线和植入后2年进行超声心动图和心电图检查。三维超声心动图评估导线干扰。Kaplan-Meier 分析比较导线所致 TR（LITR）组与功能性 TR（FTR）组的无事件生存率。Cox 回归确定不良结局的预测因素。

结果：尽管 LBBAP 组的基线心力衰竭负担高于 RVP 组（P< .001），但在25.8个月的随访中，LBBAP 显示出最低的 TR 进展率（20.0% vs RVAP 43.3% vs RVSP 35.9%，P=.020）。在机制上，LBBAP 缩短了 QRS 时限（与 RVP 的增宽相比，P< .001），并且导线干扰少于 RVAP（28.0% vs 50.5%，P= .009）。此外，LBBAP 显示出更大的左心逆重构和二尖瓣反流改善，同时比 RVP 更好地保留了右心结构和功能。在37.4个月的随访中，LITR 的结局比 FTR 更差（P= .03）。LITR、肺动脉高压、左心室射血分数降低和肌酐升高是不良结局的独立预测因素。

结论：与 RVP 相比，LBBAP 与较少的 CIED 诱发 TR 相关，可能通过减少机械干扰、更优的电同步性和有利的心脏重构实现。此外，LITR 与比 FTR 更差的预后相关。

title: Utility of an automatic and patient-triggered cardiac event recorder: experience in children.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic yield of an event recorder capable of automatic and manual recording in children with possible arrhythmia related symptoms.

METHODS: We evaluated retrospectively 81 children monitored with Novacor event recorder system between September 2021 and September 2024. All of the patients performed 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG), 24-hour-Holter monitoring, and echocardiography before the cardiac event recording.

RESULTS: Indications for cardiac event recorder monitoring were palpitations in 59 (72.8%) patients, chest pain and palpitations in 19 (23.5%) patients, and palpitations and presyncope in 3 (3.7%) patients. After a mean monitoring period of 14.40 ± 7.79 days, 65 (80%) children described symptoms and 41(63%) children had automatically or manually recorded arrhythmias. 63% of these arrhythmias were correlated with the symptoms. Of the 16 (19,8%) patients who were asymptomatic during the enrollment period, 9 (56%) had arrhythmia recorded with automatic arrhythmia detection property only. A total of 107 arrhythmias episodes were registered; forty-six (43%) episodes were patient triggered, and 61 (57%) were automatically recorded. While 24-hour-Holter monitoring detected a clinical diagnosis in 13 patients (16.7%), event recorder diagnosed clinical arrhythmia in 41 children (63%). Based on the event recorder and findings, 10 (12,3%) patients received an electrophysiology study/ablation.

CONCLUSION: We found that the automatic mode of the device provided additional clinical and therapeutic consequences. For this reason, a cardiac event recorder capable of automatically and manually recording may be a more preferable method in children with potentially arrhythmia related symptoms. Studies with larger patient series may provide illuminating data in this area.

AI.tldr: 在81例有疑似心律失常症状的儿童中，自动+手动事件记录仪诊断心律失常的阳性率（63%）显著高于24小时动态心电图（16.7%），且自动模式在无症状患儿中额外检出56%的心律失常。
AI.motivation: 儿童心悸、胸痛等症状常呈阵发性，常规24小时动态心电图（Holter）监测窗口短，可能漏诊心律失常；兼具自动检测与患者触发功能的事件记录仪在儿童中的诊断价值尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2021年9月至2024年9月接受Novacor事件记录仪监测的81例儿童。所有患儿监测前均完成12导联心电图、24小时Holter和超声心动图。记录仪支持自动检测和手动触发两种模式。主要终点为事件记录仪诊断临床心律失常的阳性率，并与24小时Holter比较；同时分析症状-心律失常相关性及自动模式额外检出情况。
AI.result: 监测指征：心悸59例（72.8%）、胸痛+心悸19例（23.5%）、心悸+晕厥前兆3例（3.7%）。平均监测14.40±7.79天。65例（80%）报告症状，41例（63%）记录到自动或手动心律失常，其中63%与症状相关。16例（19.8%）监测期间无症状，其中9例（56%）仅通过自动检测模式记录到心律失常。共记录107次心律失常发作，患者触发46次（43%），自动记录61次（57%）。24小时Holter诊断临床心律失常13例（16.7%），事件记录仪诊断41例（63%）。基于事件记录仪结果，10例（12.3%）接受了电生理检查/消融。
AI.conclusion: 在儿童中，兼具自动和手动记录功能的事件记录仪诊断心律失常的阳性率显著高于24小时Holter，自动模式对无症状患儿有额外诊断价值，并影响了12.3%患者的电生理干预决策。对于疑似心律失常相关症状的儿童，该设备可能是更优的监测选择；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限，结论需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究旨在评估一种能够自动和手动记录的事件记录器在具有可能心律失常相关症状的儿童中的诊断率。

方法：我们回顾性评估了2021年9月至2024年9月期间使用Novacor事件记录器系统监测的81名儿童。所有患者在进行心脏事件记录前均完成了12导联心电图（ECG）、24小时动态心电图监测和超声心动图检查。

结果：进行心脏事件记录器监测的指征为：心悸59例（72.8%），胸痛和心悸19例（23.5%），心悸和先兆晕厥3例（3.7%）。平均监测时间为14.40 ± 7.79天后，65名（80%）儿童描述了症状，41名（63%）儿童自动或手动记录了心律失常。这些心律失常中63%与症状相关。在入组期间无症状的16名（19.8%）患者中，9名（56%）仅通过自动心律失常检测功能记录了心律失常。共记录到107次心律失常发作；其中46次（43%）为患者触发，61次（57%）为自动记录。24小时动态心电图监测在13名患者（16.7%）中检测到临床诊断，而事件记录器在41名儿童（63%）中诊断了临床心律失常。基于事件记录器的发现，10名（12.3%）患者接受了电生理检查/消融术。

结论：我们发现设备的自动模式提供了额外的临床和治疗意义。因此，对于具有潜在心律失常相关症状的儿童，能够自动和手动记录的心脏事件记录器可能是更可取的方法。更大患者系列的研究可能为该领域提供有启发性的数据。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cardiac Electrophysiology Ethics, Explainability, Equity, and the Road Ahead.
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming cardiac electrophysiology (EP) by enabling automated interpretation of electrocardiograms, intracardiac electrograms, wearable sensor data, and imaging modalities. These technologies promise improved diagnostic accuracy, procedural efficiency, and personalized risk stratification across a wide spectrum of arrhythmia care. However, the integration of AI into clinical EP raises important ethical, practical, and regulatory concerns. Many current models function as opaque systems with limited explainability, while training datasets often lack adequate representation across sex, race, geography, and socioeconomic status. These limitations raise the risk of biased performance, reduced generalizability, and erosion of clinician trust. Furthermore, cost, infrastructure requirements, and regulatory complexity threaten equitable global adoption. This review examines the ethical foundations of AI in electrophysiology, focusing on dataset bias, fairness, explainability, and accountability. We discuss the clinical consequences of black box models, outline strategies to improve transparency, and explore emerging regulatory and legal frameworks. Finally, we highlight future horizons including digital twins, multimodal risk engines, and real time procedural guidance systems. Responsible deployment of AI in EP will require rigorous validation, continuous monitoring, clinician oversight, and intentional efforts to ensure equitable access across diverse populations.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出，AI 在心脏电生理领域的应用面临模型可解释性不足、训练数据代表性欠缺和全球公平可及性受限等伦理与监管挑战，需通过严格验证、持续监测和临床医生监督实现负责任落地。
AI.motivation: AI 正快速进入心脏电生理，用于心电图、心内电图、可穿戴传感器数据和影像的自动判读，有望提高诊断准确性、手术效率和个体化风险分层；但现有模型多为黑箱、训练数据在性别、种族、地域和社会经济地位方面代表性不足，可能带来偏倚性能、泛化性下降和临床信任受损，成本、基础设施和监管复杂性也威胁全球公平应用，既往证据缺乏对上述伦理与实施问题的系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，非原始研究，摘要未报告样本量、研究对象、干预或暴露、终点定义及统计方法；综述聚焦心脏电生理中 AI 的伦理基础，围绕数据集偏倚、公平性、可解释性和问责制展开，讨论黑箱模型的临床后果，梳理提升透明度的策略，并探讨新兴监管与法律框架及未来方向（数字孪生、多模态风险引擎、实时手术引导系统）。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果，未提供效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；定性结论为：当前多数模型为不透明系统、可解释性有限，训练数据集在性别、种族、地理和社会经济地位方面常缺乏充分代表性，可能导致性能偏倚、泛化性降低和临床医生信任下降，成本、基础设施要求和监管复杂性威胁全球公平采用。
AI.conclusion: AI 在心脏电生理的负责任部署需要严格验证、持续监测、临床医生监督，并有意确保不同人群的公平可及；本文为综述性论述，未提供原始数据或定量证据，相关策略和监管框架的实际效果尚待前瞻性研究验证，对电生理实践的影响在于提示在采纳 AI 工具时需关注可解释性、数据代表性和公平性。

summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）通过实现心电图、心内电图、可穿戴传感器数据和影像模态的自动解读，正在迅速改变心脏电生理学（EP）。这些技术有望在广泛的心律失常诊疗中提高诊断准确性、手术效率和个性化风险分层。然而，将AI整合到临床EP中引发了重要的伦理、实践和监管问题。许多当前模型作为不透明系统运行，可解释性有限，而训练数据集往往在性别、种族、地理和社会经济地位方面缺乏充分代表性。这些局限性增加了性能偏倚、泛化性降低和临床医生信任侵蚀的风险。此外，成本、基础设施要求和监管复杂性威胁着全球公平采用。本综述探讨了EP中AI的伦理基础，重点关注数据集偏倚、公平性、可解释性和问责制。我们讨论了黑箱模型的临床后果，概述了提高透明度的策略，并探讨了新兴的监管和法律框架。最后，我们强调了未来前景，包括数字孪生、多模态风险引擎和实时手术指导系统。在EP中负责任地部署AI将需要严格的验证、持续监测、临床医生监督以及有意识的努力，以确保不同人群的公平可及性。

title: Trends in Preventing Sudden Cardiac Death in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
summary: Background: Contemporary series report declining sudden cardiac death (SCD) in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), but whether this reflects fewer arrhythmic events or a greater proportion of deaths successfully prevented is unclear. We examined the proportion of arrhythmic events that were prevented rather than fatal over two decades, and its determinants. Methods: We conducted a systematic review of observational HCM cohorts published in 2000–2024 reporting SCD, resuscitated cardiac arrest (RCA) and appropriate ICD discharge (ICD-d). The primary outcome, the prevented fraction, was (RCA + ICD-d)/(SCD + RCA + ICD-d). Proportions were pooled using random-effects models (Freeman–Tukey transformation), compared between periods (2000–2013 vs. 2014–2024) and examined by meta-regression. Results: Fourteen cohorts (14,069 patients; 712 arrhythmic events) were included. The prevented fraction was 53.2% (95% CI 36.0–70.1) overall, and higher in 2014–2024 than in 2000–2013, (60.8% vs. 27.7%; p = 0.08), although this comparison relied on only three cohorts in the first period. This variation was strongly associated with cohort ICD penetration (β = 0.022, p < 0.0001), which explained 72% of the between-study heterogeneity, whereas calendar year was not independently associated (p = 0.45 when adjusted for ICD penetration). SCD fell from 72.3% to 39.2% of events while appropriate discharges rose from 9.8% to 40.5%; the share prevented by resuscitation did not increase. SCD incidence fell from 0.69 to 0.27 per 100 patient-years, while appropriate discharges rose from 0.10 to 0.27; the yield per implanted device did not improve (16.7% vs. 12.9%) and devices per prevented event rose from 5.8 to 8.1. Conclusions: Arrhythmic events in HCM have shifted from predominantly fatal to predominantly prevented, driven by ICD therapy rather than by the passage of time or by improved out-of-hospital resuscitation, but at the cost of broader implantation.

AI.tldr: 肥厚型心肌病心律失常事件从致命为主转向可预防为主，主要归因于ICD植入普及而非时间推移或院外复苏改善，但植入范围扩大且每预防一例事件所需器械数增加。
AI.motivation: 当代系列报告肥厚型心肌病（HCM）心脏性猝死（SCD）下降，但不清楚是心律失常事件减少还是预防成功比例增加。既往证据缺乏对预防比例及其决定因素的系统评估。
AI.method: 系统综述2000–2024年发表的观察性HCM队列，报告SCD、复苏成功心脏骤停（RCA）和适当ICD放电（ICD-d）。主要终点为预防比例=(RCA+ICD-d)/(SCD+RCA+ICD-d)。采用随机效应模型（Freeman–Tukey变换）合并比例，比较2000–2013与2014–2024两个时期，并行meta回归分析。
AI.result: 纳入14个队列（14,069例患者；712次心律失常事件）。总体预防比例为53.2%（95%CI 36.0–70.1），2014–2024年高于2000–2013年（60.8% vs 27.7%；p=0.08），但第一时期仅3个队列。预防比例与队列ICD渗透率强相关（β=0.022，p<0.0001），解释72%的异质性；校正ICD渗透率后日历年无独立关联（p=0.45）。SCD占事件比例从72.3%降至39.2%，适当放电从9.8%升至40.5%；复苏预防比例未增加。SCD发生率从0.69降至0.27/100患者年，适当放电从0.10升至0.27；每植入器械产出未改善（16.7% vs 12.9%），每预防一例事件所需器械从5.8升至8.1。
AI.conclusion: HCM心律失常事件已从致命为主转向可预防为主，驱动力为ICD治疗而非时间推移或院外复苏改善，但代价是更广泛的植入。临床意义在于ICD是降低HCM猝死的关键，但需权衡过度植入；局限性包括第一时期队列少、观察性设计及ICD渗透率混杂。

summary_zh:
背景：当代系列研究报告显示肥厚型心肌病（HCM）中的心脏性猝死（SCD）发生率下降，但这是否反映了心律失常事件减少，还是成功预防的死亡比例增加，尚不清楚。我们研究了二十年间被预防而非致死的心律失常事件的比例及其决定因素。

方法：我们对2000-2024年发表的报告SCD、复苏成功的心脏骤停（RCA）和适当ICD放电（ICD-d）的观察性HCM队列进行了系统评价。主要结局为预防分数，计算方式为（RCA + ICD-d）/（SCD + RCA + ICD-d）。采用随机效应模型（Freeman–Tukey变换）合并比例，比较不同时期（2000-2013年 vs. 2014-2024年）并通过meta回归进行分析。

结果：共纳入14个队列（14,069例患者；712例心律失常事件）。总体预防分数为53.2%（95% CI 36.0–70.1），2014-2024年高于2000-2013年（60.8% vs. 27.7%；p = 0.08），尽管这一比较仅基于第一时期的三个队列。这种变异与队列ICD渗透率强烈相关（β = 0.022，p < 0.0001），其解释了72%的研究间异质性，而日历年并非独立相关（校正ICD渗透率后p = 0.45）。SCD占事件的比例从72.3%降至39.2%，而适当放电从9.8%升至40.5%；通过复苏预防的比例并未增加。SCD发生率从每100患者年0.69降至0.27，而适当放电从0.10升至0.27；每植入装置的获益率未改善（16.7% vs. 12.9%），每预防一例事件所需装置数从5.8升至8.1。

结论：HCM中的心律失常事件已从以致死为主转变为以预防为主，这由ICD治疗驱动，而非时间推移或院外复苏改善所致，但代价是更广泛的植入。

title: Towards a suitable biomarker for childhood screening for familial hypercholesterolemia: a systematic literature review
summary: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a common genetic disorder causing elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-c) concentrations from birth, resulting in a high risk of premature cardiovascular disease. Despite effective early treatment, FH remains underdiagnosed in children, highlighting the need for universal screening. This systematic review aims to evaluate the available evidence regarding suitable biomarkers for the purpose of universal screening for FH in childhood. The electronic databases Medline and Embase were systematically searched for studies comparing blood biomarkers in children with heterozygous FH and non-FH children. Of the 2,488 studies found, 35 were included. Although the data were constrained by considerable heterogeneity, LDL-c, total cholesterol (TC), and apolipoprotein B (ApoB) concentrations were consistently higher in children with FH across the included studies. Furthermore, increased non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (non-HDL-c), lathosterol, sitosterol and TC/HDL-c ratio, and a decreased squalene/TC ratio were found in children with FH. Only three screening studies combined biomarker (LDL-c, non-HDL-c and TC) and genetic testing simultaneously, revealing however limited sensitivity and specificity of these markers for FH screening in children. In this review, several biomarkers for FH screening in children were evaluated. As sensitivity and specificity data were generally not available or suboptimal, additional studies are needed to evaluate the screening performance of selected biomarkers in well-defined pediatric populations of suitable age and sex distribution, using valid analytical methods, and taking into account possible confounding factors. It is only through such studies that a well-considered selection of biomarkers can be made for the purpose of childhood screening for FH.

AI.tldr: 本系统综述纳入35项研究，发现FH儿童LDL-c、TC、ApoB等生物标志物持续升高，但仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物与基因检测，敏感性和特异性有限，尚缺乏可用于儿童普筛的可靠标志物。
AI.motivation: 家族性高胆固醇血症（FH）为常见遗传病，自出生起LDL-c即升高，早发心血管病风险高；早期治疗有效，但儿童FH诊断率低，亟需普筛策略。既往缺乏对儿童FH筛查适用生物标志物的系统评估，本研究旨在填补该证据缺口。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索Medline与Embase，纳入比较杂合型FH儿童与非FH儿童血液生物标志物的研究。共检出2,488项研究，最终纳入35项。主要比较LDL-c、TC、ApoB、非HDL-c、拉索固醇、谷固醇、TC/HDL-c比值及角鲨烯/TC比值等指标；同时评估生物标志物联合基因检测的筛查效能（敏感性、特异性）。摘要未报告具体合并统计方法及异质性量化指标。
AI.result: 数据异质性较大。所纳入研究中，FH儿童LDL-c、TC及ApoB浓度一致高于非FH儿童；非HDL-c、拉索固醇、谷固醇及TC/HDL-c比值升高，角鲨烯/TC比值降低。仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物（LDL-c、非HDL-c、TC）与基因检测，显示这些标志物用于儿童FH筛查的敏感性和特异性有限。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 多种生物标志物在FH儿童中呈一致变化，但敏感性和特异性数据普遍缺失或欠佳，尚不足以支持将其用于儿童普筛。需在年龄与性别分布明确、分析方法可靠并控制混杂因素的儿科人群中进一步研究，方能筛选出适合儿童FH普筛的标志物。本研究属遗传与基础方向，对电生理实践无直接影响。

summary_zh: 家族性高胆固醇血症（FH）是一种常见的遗传性疾病，自出生起即导致低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-c）浓度升高，从而造成早发心血管疾病的高风险。尽管早期治疗有效，FH在儿童中仍诊断不足，凸显了普遍筛查的必要性。本系统综述旨在评估关于适用于儿童FH普遍筛查的合适生物标志物的现有证据。系统检索了电子数据库Medline和Embase，寻找比较杂合子FH儿童与非FH儿童血液生物标志物的研究。在找到的2,488项研究中，共纳入35项。尽管数据因相当大的异质性而受限，但在纳入的研究中，FH儿童的LDL-c、总胆固醇（TC）和载脂蛋白B（ApoB）浓度一致较高。此外，在FH儿童中发现非高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（非HDL-c）、拉索固醇、谷固醇和TC/HDL-c比值升高，以及角鲨烯/TC比值降低。只有三项筛查研究同时结合了生物标志物（LDL-c、非HDL-c和TC）和基因检测，然而这些标志物在儿童FH筛查中的敏感性和特异性有限。在本综述中，评估了用于儿童FH筛查的几种生物标志物。由于敏感性和特异性数据通常不可获得或欠佳，需要进一步研究在年龄和性别分布合适、定义明确的儿科人群中，使用有效的分析方法，并考虑可能的混杂因素，评估所选生物标志物的筛查性能。只有通过这样的研究，才能为儿童FH筛查目的做出深思熟虑的生物标志物选择。

title: Cardiac phenotype in children with X-linked ichthyosis (STS-sEDD): findings from a prospective cohort
summary: X-linked ichthyosis is caused by pathogenic variants or deletions involving STS at Xp22.31. Because some deletions include contiguous genes and cardiac rhythm abnormalities have been reported, we characterized the cardiac phenotype of children with genetically confirmed steroid sulfatase-related syndromic epidermal differentiation disorder (STS-sEDD). This prospective, observational, single-centre study included 14 boys aged 2-16 years. Assessment comprised clinical history and examination, 12-lead electrocardiography, echocardiography, exercise testing when age-appropriate, and 5-day ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring. Genetic findings were reviewed, and 11 obligate-carrier mothers also underwent cardiological assessment. Nine patients (64%) were asymptomatic and five (36%) reported mild, nonspecific symptoms. Minor electrocardiographic findings in 11 patients were considered age-appropriate variants. All hearts were structurally normal except for one previously known, haemodynamically compensated partial anomalous pulmonary venous return. Exercise testing in 12 patients identified one isolated premature ventricular contraction; 5-day monitoring in 13 detected no clinically significant arrhythmia. Twelve patients had contiguous-gene deletions and two had pathogenic STS sequence variants, with no apparent association between deletion extent and cardiac findings. Maternal echocardiograms were normal; one mother had isolated atrial and ventricular ectopy during exercise without clinically significant arrhythmia.Conclusion Clinically relevant cardiac involvement appeared uncommon in this small pediatric cohort. The sample size and cross-sectional assessment preclude definitive risk estimates; cardiological evaluation should be individualized according to symptoms, cardiovascular findings, and family history.What is known • X-linked ichthyosis is caused by STS variants or deletions that may involve contiguous genes. • Cardiac arrhythmias have been reported with Xp22.31 deletions, but pediatric data are scarce.What is new • No clinically significant arrhythmia was found in 14 boys undergoing multimodal assessment. • Deletion extent did not predict cardiac findings; follow-up should reflect symptoms and family history.

AI.tldr: 在14例X连锁鱼鳞病男孩中，多模态心脏评估未发现临床显著心律失常，心脏结构正常，提示临床相关心脏受累不常见。
AI.motivation: X连锁鱼鳞病由STS基因变异或Xp22.31缺失所致，缺失可能累及邻近基因，既往有心脏节律异常报道，但儿童数据稀缺，需明确该人群心脏表型以指导临床评估。
AI.method: 前瞻性、观察性、单中心队列研究，纳入14例基因确诊的STS相关综合征性表皮分化障碍男孩（2-16岁），评估包括病史与体检、12导联心电图、超声心动图、适龄运动试验及5天动态心电图监测，并回顾基因结果；11例必然携带者母亲也接受心脏评估。
AI.result: 9例（64%）无症状，5例（36%）有轻微非特异性症状；11例心电图轻微改变视为年龄相关变异；除1例已知血流动力学代偿的部分性肺静脉异位引流外，心脏结构均正常；12例运动试验中1例出现孤立性室性早搏，13例5天监测未发现临床显著心律失常；12例为连续基因缺失，2例为STS致病序列变异，缺失范围与心脏发现无明显关联；母亲超声心动图正常，1例运动时出现孤立性房性与室性异位搏动，无临床显著心律失常。
AI.conclusion: 该小样本儿童队列中临床相关心脏受累不常见，缺失范围未预测心脏发现；但样本量小且为横断面评估，无法确定风险估计，心脏评估应根据症状、心血管发现和家族史个体化进行。

summary_zh: X连锁鱼鳞病由Xp22.31上STS的致病性变异或缺失引起。由于某些缺失涉及相邻基因，且已有心律异常的报告，我们对经基因确诊的类固醇硫酸酯酶相关综合征性表皮分化障碍（STS-sEDD）儿童的心脏表型进行了特征描述。这项前瞻性、观察性、单中心研究纳入了14名2-16岁的男孩。评估包括临床病史和检查、12导联心电图、超声心动图、适龄时的运动试验以及5天动态心电监测。回顾了遗传学发现，11名肯定携带者母亲也接受了心脏病学评估。9名患者（64%）无症状，5名（36%）报告了轻微、非特异性症状。11名患者的心电图轻微发现被认为是与年龄相符的变异。除了一例已知的、血流动力学代偿的部分性肺静脉异位引流外，所有心脏结构均正常。12名患者的运动试验发现一例孤立的室性早搏；13名患者的5天监测未检测到有临床意义的心律失常。12名患者有相邻基因缺失，2名有致病性STS序列变异，缺失范围与心脏发现之间无明显关联。母亲超声心动图正常；一位母亲在运动期间出现孤立的房性和室性异位搏动，无临床意义的心律失常。结论 在这个小型儿科队列中，有临床相关的心脏受累似乎不常见。样本量和横断面评估妨碍了确定性的风险估计；心脏病学评估应根据症状、心血管发现和家族史进行个体化。已知 • X连锁鱼鳞病由可能涉及相邻基因的STS变异或缺失引起。 • 已有Xp22.31缺失伴心律失常的报告，但儿科数据稀少。新发现 • 在接受多模式评估的14名男孩中未发现有临床意义的心律失常。 • 缺失范围不能预测心脏发现；随访应反映症状和家族史。

title: Case Report: Duchenne muscular dystrophy-associated cardiomyopathy presenting as adolescent nonischemic heart failure-from red-flag clues to genetic confirmation and multisystem management.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) can involve the myocardium and progress to cardiomyopathy and heart failure; however, diagnosis is frequently delayed because initial clinical manifestations are often atypical. In adolescent males presenting with nonischemic cardiomyopathy of unclear etiology, early integration of a coherent evidence chain spanning neuromuscular clues, multimodality imaging, and genetic testing is pivotal for etiologic clarification and optimization of long-term management.

CASE SUMMARY: The patient was a 17-year-old adolescent male who presented repeatedly with chest tightness, fatigue, and reduced exercise tolerance. During the first hospitalization in September 2025, evaluation revealed left atrial and left ventricular enlargement with impaired systolic function (LVEF ∼44%). Laboratory testing showed marked hyperCKemia (CK 1,451 U/L), mildly elevated hs-cTnT (0.033 μg/L), and concomitant transaminase elevation. Coronary computed tomography angiography demonstrated no significant stenosis, with only a superficial myocardial bridge in the mid-left anterior descending artery. According to the original clinical cardiac magnetic resonance report, multifocal patchy late gadolinium enhancement was described predominantly in a subepicardial distribution, together with a trabeculated/noncompaction-like left ventricular morphology. During the second hospitalization in November 2025, focused neuromuscular assessment uncovered a long-standing progressive proximal weakness (EMG-supported), linking the cardiac phenotype to dystrophinopathy (positive Gower's sign, calf pseudohypertrophy, and waddling gait), and electromyography supported a myopathic process; transthoracic echocardiography showed improvement of LVEF to 50%. At the third hospitalization in December 2025, the dominant issues were hyperglycemia with proteinuria (HbA1c 7.7% and UACR ∼389 mg/g), while echocardiography documented further recovery of LVEF to 55%. Genetic testing identified a DMD variant (NM_004006.3:c.1351G>T, p.Asp451Tyr), and Sanger sequencing confirmed hemizygosity in the proband and heterozygosity in his mother. Taken together, the convergent clinical, imaging, electrophysiologic, and genetic findings established the diagnosis of DMD-associated cardiomyopathy. Under guideline-directed heart failure therapy and multidisciplinary care, the patient demonstrated longitudinal improvement in cardiac function (LVEF ∼44% → 50% → 55%).

CONCLUSION: In adolescent males with nonischemic cardiomyopathy and/or heart failure of unclear etiology-particularly when accompanied by hyperCKemia or suspected myogenic transaminase elevation-dystrophinopathy should be considered early in the differential diagnosis. A diagnostic "closed loop" can be achieved by integrating cardiac phenotyping, neuromuscular examination, electromyography, family history, and confirmatory genetic testing, while guideline-directed heart failure therapy and proactive family-based care (including cardiac surveillance of female carriers) should be initiated in parallel to improve long-term outcomes.

AI.tldr: 一例17岁男性以非缺血性心力衰竭起病，经神经肌肉线索、影像与基因检测确诊DMD相关心肌病，规范心衰治疗后LVEF从44%恢复至55%。
AI.motivation: DMD可累及心肌并进展为心肌病和心力衰竭，但早期临床表现常不典型，诊断易延迟。对于病因不明的青少年男性非缺血性心肌病，如何整合神经肌肉线索、多模态影像和基因检测以明确病因并优化长期管理，是临床亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例17岁男性，反复胸闷、乏力、运动耐量下降。三次住院期间完成实验室检查、冠状动脉CTA、心脏磁共振、经胸超声心动图、神经肌肉评估、肌电图及基因检测（Sanger测序验证）。主要观察心脏结构功能、心肌损伤/肌酶指标、神经肌肉体征及基因变异，并追踪指南导向心衰治疗下的纵向变化。
AI.result: 首次住院（2025年9月）示左房左室扩大、LVEF约44%，CK 1,451 U/L、hs-cTnT 0.033 μg/L、转氨酶升高；冠脉CTA无显著狭窄，仅前降支中段浅表心肌桥；心脏磁共振报告多灶斑片状晚期钆增强，主要呈心外膜下分布，伴左室小梁化/致密化不全样形态。第二次住院（2025年11月）神经肌肉评估发现长期进行性近端肌无力（肌电图支持肌病过程），Gower征阳性、腓肠肌假性肥大、鸭步；超声LVEF改善至50%。第三次住院（2025年12月）以高血糖和蛋白尿为主（HbA1c 7.7%、UACR约389 mg/g），超声LVEF进一步恢复至55%。基因检测发现DMD变异（NM_004006.3:c.1351G>T，p.Asp451Tyr），Sanger测序证实先证者半合子、母亲杂合。
AI.conclusion: 对于病因不明的青少年男性非缺血性心肌病和/或心力衰竭，尤其伴高CK血症或疑似肌源性转氨酶升高时，应早期将抗肌萎缩蛋白病纳入鉴别诊断。整合心脏表型、神经肌肉检查、肌电图、家族史和确诊性基因检测可形成诊断闭环，同时应启动指南导向心衰治疗和以家庭为基础的主动管理（包括女性携带者心脏监测），以改善长期预后。

summary_zh:
背景：杜氏肌营养不良（DMD）可累及心肌并进展为心肌病和心力衰竭；然而，由于初始临床表现常不典型，诊断常被延误。对于表现为病因不明的非缺血性心肌病的青少年男性，早期整合涵盖神经肌肉线索、多模态影像学和基因检测的连贯证据链，对于明确病因和优化长期管理至关重要。

病例摘要：患者为17岁青少年男性，反复出现胸闷、乏力及运动耐量下降。2025年9月首次住院期间，评估显示左心房和左心室扩大伴收缩功能受损（LVEF约44%）。实验室检查显示显著高CK血症（CK 1,451 U/L）、轻度升高的hs-cTnT（0.033 μg/L）以及伴随的转氨酶升高。冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管成像显示无明显狭窄，仅左前降支中段存在浅表心肌桥。根据原始临床心脏磁共振报告，描述为多灶性斑片状晚期钆增强，主要呈心外膜下分布，并伴有小梁化/致密化不全样左心室形态。2025年11月第二次住院期间，针对性的神经肌肉评估发现长期存在的进行性近端肌无力（肌电图支持），将心脏表型与抗肌萎缩蛋白病联系起来（Gower征阳性、小腿假性肥大和鸭步），肌电图支持肌病过程；经胸超声心动图显示LVEF改善至50%。2025年12月第三次住院时，主要问题为高血糖伴蛋白尿（HbA1c 7.7%和UACR约389 mg/g），而超声心动图记录到LVEF进一步恢复至55%。基因检测发现DMD变异（NM_004006.3:c.1351G>T，p.Asp451Tyr），Sanger测序证实先证者为半合子、其母亲为杂合子。综合上述临床、影像学、电生理和遗传学发现，确立了DMD相关心肌病的诊断。在指南导向的心力衰竭治疗和多学科护理下，患者心脏功能呈现纵向改善（LVEF约44% → 50% → 55%）。

结论：对于病因不明的非缺血性心肌病和/或心力衰竭的青少年男性——尤其是当伴有高CK血症或疑似肌源性转氨酶升高时——应在鉴别诊断中早期考虑抗肌萎缩蛋白病。通过整合心脏表型、神经肌肉检查、肌电图、家族史和确诊性基因检测，可实现诊断“闭环”，同时应并行启动指南导向的心力衰竭治疗和积极的家庭照护（包括女性携带者的心脏监测），以改善长期预后。

title: Atypical echocardiographic phenotype of end-stage hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a case series
summary: We fully documented the diagnostic process of three hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) cases without typical asymmetric myocardial hypertrophy, including medical histories, imaging, and laboratory tests, ultimately confirming the diagnosis through genetic testing. Case 1 presented with segmental wall motion abnormalities with thrombosis, requiring differentiation from coronary atherosclerotic heart disease; case 2 presented with restrictive hemodynamic changes that could be confused with restrictive cardiomyopathy such as amyloidosis; case 3 occurred in a pediatric setting and showed diffuse and concentric hypertrophy similar to metabolic disorders. Various imaging examinations were employed for differential diagnosis, and whole-exome sequencing identified a pathogenic MYBPC3 mutation in case 1 and pathogenic MYH7 mutations in cases 2 and 3, including a de novo variant in case 3. We provided appropriate treatment and follow-up for each case. Case 1's left ventricular ejection fraction increased to 48%, and cases 2 and 3 have not experienced worsening heart failure or malignant arrhythmic events based on an optimized drug regimen. This case series confirms the diversity of echocardiographic phenotypes in end-stage HCM, underscoring the role of multimodal imaging and genetic testing in diagnosis and differential diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 三例缺乏典型非对称性肥厚的终末期HCM，经多模态影像与基因检测确诊，分别携带MYBPC3或MYH7致病突变，优化药物治疗后病情稳定。
AI.motivation: 终末期肥厚型心肌病（HCM）通常表现为非对称性室壁肥厚，但部分病例超声心动图表现不典型，易与冠心病、限制型心肌病或代谢性疾病混淆，导致误诊。既往对这类不典型表型的认识有限，需强调多模态影像和基因检测在鉴别诊断中的作用。
AI.method: 病例系列研究，纳入3例无典型非对称性心肌肥厚的终末期HCM患者，收集病史、影像学及实验室检查，采用全外显子组测序确认诊断。病例1表现为节段性室壁运动异常伴血栓形成，需与冠状动脉粥样硬化性心脏病鉴别；病例2表现为限制性血流动力学改变，需与淀粉样变性等限制型心肌病鉴别；病例3为儿童患者，表现为弥漫性同心性肥厚，类似代谢性疾病。各病例均接受相应治疗和随访。
AI.result: 基因检测显示病例1携带MYBPC3致病突变，病例2和3分别携带MYH7致病突变（病例3为新发变异）。治疗后，病例1左心室射血分数提高至48%；病例2和3在优化药物治疗方案下未发生心力衰竭恶化或恶性心律失常事件。摘要未报告其他定量统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例系列证实终末期HCM的超声心动图表型具有多样性，多模态影像联合基因检测对诊断和鉴别诊断至关重要。临床实践中应警惕不典型表现，避免误诊；但样本量小，结论需更大规模研究验证。

title: Beyond the light-driven pacemaker: the suprachiasmatic nucleus as a dynamic coordinator of environmental cues
summary: The suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) is the central mammalian circadian pacemaker, but its function extends beyond passive entrainment to light. Here, we synthesize evidence that the SCN is a heterogeneous and plastic network that integrates photic, metabolic, astrocytic, and thermal information across daily entrainment, seasonal adaptation, jet lag, and chronic circadian misalignment. VIP and GRP neurons provide privileged access for retinal input and network synchronization, AVP neurons support intrinsic rhythmicity and output, and the broad Nms -expressing ensemble and CCK-defined subtypes contribute to arousal and adaptive network plasticity. We propose an integrative circuit model in which retinal signals preferentially engage core VIP/GRP neurons, whereas feeding and metabolic information influences VIP and AVP populations through circulating factors, the dorsomedial hypothalamus, the intergeniculate leaflet, and metabolically responsive astrocytes. Rhythmic astrocytic GABA and glutamate release, together with VIP-AVP coupling and overlapping VIP + /NMS + and AVP + /NMS + subpopulations, may coordinate phase resetting and sleep-wake rhythms. The timing mechanism underlying food anticipatory activity (FAA) is attributed primarily to distributed extra-SCN food-entrainable circuits, whereas the SCN may gate or modulate its behavioral expression rather than generate it autonomously. Light remains the dominant zeitgeber. Under standard light-dark conditions, time-restricted feeding more commonly modulates SCN neuronal activity, calcium dynamics, neuropeptide output, and behavior than resets the core TTFL; molecular resetting has been reported only under specific genetic, temporal, dietary, lighting, or network conditions. When light and feeding cues conflict, rapid ventral resetting and slower dorsal reentrainment generate transient intranuclear and systemic desynchrony rather than simple dominance by either cue. Biological sex and aging further shape this integrative capacity, while temperature compensation delineates the boundary between resistance to routine thermal fluctuations and conditional responses to stronger thermal challenges. This framework helps explain circadian disruption in jet lag, shift work, social jetlag, and metabolic disease, and supports circadian medicine strategies that align timed light, feeding, exercise, sleep, and pharmacotherapy across central and peripheral clocks.

AI.tldr: 综述提出视交叉上核是整合光、代谢、星形胶质细胞与温度线索的异质性可塑性网络，而非仅被动接受光授时，并据此构建整合环路模型解释时差与代谢病中的节律紊乱。
AI.motivation: 既往将视交叉上核视为以光为主要授时因子的被动起搏器，但难以解释限时进食、代谢信号、星形胶质细胞及温度在节律调控中的作用，以及光与进食线索冲突时的去同步现象，故需重新界定其网络功能。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述与整合性证据综合，未纳入特定样本或开展原始统计；汇总视交叉上核神经元亚群（VIP、GRP、AVP、Nms、CCK）、星形胶质细胞、视网膜输入及代谢通路的解剖与功能证据，覆盖日常授时、季节适应、时差与慢性节律错位情境，并提出整合环路模型；摘要未报告定量终点与统计方法。
AI.result: 提出视网膜信号优先作用于核心 VIP/GRP 神经元，进食与代谢信息经循环因子、背内侧下丘脑、膝状体间小叶及代谢反应性星形胶质细胞影响 VIP 与 AVP 群体；节律性星形胶质细胞 GABA/谷氨酸释放与 VIP-AVP 耦联及 VIP+/NMS+、AVP+/NMS+ 重叠亚群可能协调相位重置与睡眠-觉醒节律。食物预期活动主要由视交叉上核外的分布式可进食性环路计时，视交叉上核更多是门控或调节其行为表达。光仍为优势授时因子；标准光暗条件下限时进食多调节视交叉上核神经元活动、钙动态、神经肽输出与行为，而非重置核心转录-翻译反馈环路，分子重置仅在特定遗传、时间、饮食、光照或网络条件下被报道。光与进食线索冲突时，腹侧快速重置与背侧缓慢再同步造成暂时性核内与系统性去同步，而非单一线索主导。生物性别与衰老塑造该整合能力，温度补偿界定对常规温度波动的抵抗与对更强热挑战的条件性反应之间的边界。摘要未报告具体效应量与 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将视交叉上核定位为动态整合环境线索的协调者，有助于解释时差、轮班、社会性时差与代谢病中的节律紊乱，并支持在中枢与外周时钟层面联合定时光照、进食、运动、睡眠与药物治疗的节律医学策略；作为综述性模型，其推论尚缺乏原始定量验证，对电生理实践的直接指导有限，相关环路假说需进一步实验证实。

summary_zh: 视交叉上核（SCN）是哺乳动物的中枢昼夜节律起搏器，但其功能不仅限于被动接受光授时。在此，我们综合证据表明，SCN是一个异质性且可塑的网络，在每日授时、季节性适应、时差反应和慢性昼夜节律失调中整合光、代谢、星形胶质细胞和温度信息。VIP和GRP神经元为视网膜输入和网络同步提供优先通路，AVP神经元支持内在节律性和输出，而广泛表达Nms的神经元群和CCK定义的亚型则参与觉醒和适应性网络可塑性。我们提出一个整合性回路模型，其中视网膜信号优先激活核心VIP/GRP神经元，而摄食和代谢信息通过循环因子、下丘脑背内侧核、膝状体间小叶和代谢反应性星形胶质细胞影响VIP和AVP群体。节律性星形胶质细胞GABA和谷氨酸释放，连同VIP-AVP耦合以及重叠的VIP+/NMS+和AVP+/NMS+亚群，可能协调相位重置和睡眠-觉醒节律。食物预期活动（FAA）背后的计时机制主要归因于分布式的SCN外食物可授时回路，而SCN可能门控或调节其行为表达，而非自主产生该活动。光仍是主导授时因子。在标准光暗条件下，限时进食更常见地调节SCN神经元活动、钙动态、神经肽输出和行为，而非重置核心TTFL；分子重置仅在特定遗传、时间、饮食、光照或网络条件下被报道。当光和进食线索冲突时，快速的腹侧重置和较慢的背侧再授时产生瞬时的核内和全身性去同步，而非任一线索的简单主导。生物学性别和衰老进一步塑造这种整合能力，而温度补偿划定了对常规温度波动的抵抗与对更强温度挑战的条件性反应之间的边界。该框架有助于解释时差、轮班工作、社会时差和代谢疾病中的昼夜节律紊乱，并支持在中央和外周时钟中协调定时光照、进食、运动、睡眠和药物治疗的昼夜节律医学策略。

title: AXIN1 Gene Polymorphism in Fatal Cardiomyopathy Cases: A Cross-Sectional Autopsy Study in Myanmar
summary: Background: Cardiomyopathies are important causes of sudden cardiac death, and genetic variation contributes to their pathogenesis. AXIN1 encodes a scaffold protein that negatively regulates the Wnt/β-catenin pathway, which has essential roles in cardiac development and remodelling. The AXIN1 single-nucleotide polymorphism rs1805105 has been associated with susceptibility to dilated cardiomyopathy in a Chinese Han population, but evidence from medicolegal autopsy populations in Myanmar is lacking. Objective: To determine the distribution of AXIN1 rs1805105 genotypes and examine their association with types of fatal cardiomyopathy. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional descriptive study included 50 consecutives, histologically confirmed fatal cardiomyopathy cases received for medicolegal autopsy at Mandalay General Hospital from June 2020 to May 2021. Cardiomyopathy type was determined by gross and histopathological examination. DNA extracted from cardiac blood was genotyped for AXIN1 rs1805105 using polymerase chain reaction-restriction fragment length polymorphism (PCR-RFLP). Descriptive statistics and Fisher’s exact test were used. Results: The mean age was 46.04 ± 13.11 years; 40 cases (80%) were male. Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) was identified in 38 cases (76%), hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) in 11 (22%), and restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM) in one (2%). Genotype frequencies were CT in 25 cases (50%), TT in 16 (32%), and CC in nine (18%). Among DCM cases, CT was most frequent (21/38, 55.3%), followed by TT (10/38, 26.3%) and CC (7/38, 18.4%). Genotype distribution differed descriptively across cardiomyopathy types but was not statistically significant (Fisher’s exact p = 0.124). Genotype distribution was also not associated with sex (p = 0.809). Conclusion: AXIN1 rs1805105 variation was present in fatal cardiomyopathy cases, with the CT genotype predominating overall and in DCM. However, this small descriptive autopsy series did not demonstrate a statistically significant association between rs1805105 genotype and cardiomyopathy type. Larger case-control and multicentre studies evaluating additional variants are required.

title: Ventricular Fibrillation in PRKAG2 Cardiomyopathy: A Genetic Arrhythmia Substrate Beyond Wolff-Parkinson-White.
summary:
BACKGROUND: PRKAG2 syndrome is a rare autosomal dominant glycogen storage cardiomyopathy characterized by left ventricular hypertrophy, ventricular pre-excitation, and progressive conduction system disease.

CASE SUMMARY: We report the case of a 25-year-old woman with genetically confirmed PRKAG2 syndrome who presented with an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. Echocardiography revealed preserved left ventricular systolic function with mild concentric hypertrophy and marked apical thickening. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging showed anterolateral trabecular hypertrophy without evidence of myocardial fibrosis. Electrophysiological study excluded Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome and instead identified a fasciculoventricular accessory pathway. Given the occurrence of ventricular fibrillation and the associated arrhythmic risk, a transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was implanted for secondary prevention.

DISCUSSION: This case illustrates the atypical presentation of arrhythmias that deviate from classical patterns, such as those seen in Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Individualized risk assessment, close electrophysiological monitoring, and consideration of early implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation are important in PRKAG2-related cardiomyopathy.

AI.tldr: 25岁女性PRKAG2综合征患者发生院外心脏骤停，电生理检查排除WPW综合征而发现束室旁路，植入ICD进行二级预防。
AI.motivation: PRKAG2综合征是一种罕见的常染色体显性糖原贮积性心肌病，以左心室肥厚、心室预激和进行性传导系统疾病为特征。既往认为其心律失常主要与WPW综合征相关，但本例提示可能存在超越WPW的遗传性心律失常基质，需提高对非典型表现的认识。
AI.method: 本文为个案报道。研究对象为一名25岁女性，经基因确诊PRKAG2综合征，因院外心脏骤停就诊。进行了超声心动图、心脏磁共振成像和电生理检查，以明确心脏结构异常和心律失常机制。主要终点为明确心脏骤停原因及心律失常基质，并据此决定ICD植入。统计方法未报告。

title: Pathogenic Variants in NKX2-5 Associated With Familial Atrial Septal Defect and Conduction System Disease
summary: Background Most atrial septal defects (ASDs) occur sporadically, but familial cases can occur and carry a 10% risk of transmission to offspring.Case summary We describe a 3-generation family with autosomal dominant secundum ASD and conduction system disease related to a novel NKX2-5 variant (c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs∗75). The index patient, a 58-year-old woman with prior ASD repair and mitral valve replacement, presented with chronotropic incompetence, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and prolonged pauses, leading to pacemaker implantation. Her mother had an ASD, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and pulmonary arterial hypertension. The proband's daughter also had an ASD. Genetic testing revealed a novel NKX2-5 pathogenic variant in all 3 patients.Review summary The combination of an ASD and conduction system disease represents the most common phenotype in patients with pathogenic NKX2-5 variants.Take-home message A thorough family history and genetic testing are needed when evaluating patients with ASD and concurrent conduction system abnormalities.

AI.tldr: 一个三代家系中，新型NKX2-5致病性变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75）与常染色体显性遗传的房间隔缺损及传导系统疾病共分离，提示对合并传导异常的房间隔缺损患者应进行家系调查和基因检测。
AI.motivation: 大多数房间隔缺损（ASD）为散发性，但家族性病例存在且传给后代的风险约为10%。NKX2-5变异已知与ASD和传导系统疾病相关，但具体家系表现和基因型-表型关系仍需进一步描述，以指导临床识别和遗传筛查。
AI.method: 病例报告，描述一个三代家系。先证者为58岁女性，既往ASD修补术和二尖瓣置换术，因变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和长间歇植入起搏器。对其母亲和女儿进行临床评估和基因检测，采用Sanger测序或类似方法鉴定NKX2-5变异，并分析家系共分离。
AI.result: 先证者及其母亲、女儿均携带新型NKX2-5致病性变异c.300del（p.Asp101Thrfs*75）。先证者表现为ASD修补术后、二尖瓣置换术后、变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和长间歇，需起搏器植入；其母亲有ASD、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和肺动脉高压；其女儿有ASD。摘要未报告具体统计量和P值。
AI.conclusion: ASD合并传导系统疾病是NKX2-5致病性变异患者最常见的表型。临床评估ASD合并传导异常患者时，应详细采集家族史并进行基因检测，以识别家族性病例并指导家系筛查。本例为病例报告，样本量小，结论需在更大规模队列中验证。

summary_zh: 背景：大多数房间隔缺损（ASD）为散发性，但也可出现家族性病例，并具有10%的遗传给子代的风险。病例摘要：我们描述了一个三代家族，该家族患有常染色体显性继发孔型ASD和传导系统疾病，与一种新的NKX2-5变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs∗75）相关。先证者是一名58岁女性，既往接受过ASD修补术和二尖瓣置换术，因变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和长间歇就诊，导致植入起搏器。她的母亲患有ASD、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和肺动脉高压。先证者的女儿也患有ASD。基因检测显示，所有3名患者均携带一种新的NKX2-5致病性变异。综述总结：ASD合并传导系统疾病是NKX2-5致病性变异患者中最常见的表型。要点：在评估ASD合并传导系统异常的患者时，需要进行详细的家族史调查和基因检测。

title: Generation of a human induced pluripotent stem cell line (ZZUNEUi040-A) from a male patient with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy carrying a heterozygous TPM1 (c.644C > T) mutation.
summary: Tropomyosin 1 (TPM1) encodes tropomyosin alpha-1 chain, a key cardiac sarcomere component, while TPM1 mutations cause hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), a major cause of sudden cardiac death in the young. We generated the human iPSC line ZZUNEUi040-A from peripheral blood mononuclear cells of a 10-year-old male with non-obstructive asymmetric HCM carrying a heterozygous TPM1 c.644C > T (p.Ser215Leu) mutation via Sendai virus non-integrating reprogramming technology. The line showed normal karyotype (46,XY), undifferentiated hPSC-State markers, and trilineage differentiation potential, serving as a valuable model for HCM pathogenesis studies and drug screening.

AI.tldr: 从携带TPM1 c.644C>T杂合突变的10岁男性非梗阻性不对称性HCM患者外周血单核细胞成功建立人iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A，核型正常且具三胚层分化潜能。
AI.motivation: TPM1编码心肌肌节关键组分原肌球蛋白α-1链，其突变可导致肥厚型心肌病（HCM），是年轻人心脏性猝死的重要原因；目前缺乏携带该突变的患者来源人iPSC模型，限制了HCM发病机制研究与药物筛选。
AI.method: 基础研究。研究对象为1例10岁男性非梗阻性不对称性HCM患者，携带TPM1 c.644C>T（p.Ser215Leu）杂合突变。取其外周血单核细胞，采用Sendai病毒非整合重编程技术建立人iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A。鉴定内容包括核型分析、未分化hPSC状态标志物表达及三胚层分化潜能；摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 所建iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A核型正常（46,XY），表达未分化hPSC状态标志物，并具备三胚层分化潜能。摘要未报告定量标志物表达水平、分化效率及统计学比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 该患者来源iPSC系为TPM1相关HCM的发病机制研究和药物筛选提供了有价值的体外模型；但摘要未报告功能验证或疾病表型数据，其模拟HCM病理的效力尚待进一步研究，且为单例细胞系，代表性有限。

summary_zh: Tropomyosin 1（TPM1）编码原肌球蛋白α-1链，是心脏肌节的关键组成成分，而TPM1突变可导致肥厚型心肌病（HCM），后者是年轻人心脏性猝死的主要原因。我们通过Sendai病毒非整合重编程技术，从一名携带杂合TPM1 c.644C > T（p.Ser215Leu）突变的10岁男性非梗阻性不对称性HCM患者的外周血单个核细胞中，建立了人iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A。该细胞系显示正常核型（46,XY）、未分化hPSC-State标志物以及三胚层分化潜能，可作为HCM发病机制研究和药物筛选的有价值模型。

title: Multi-class electrocardiogram signal classification using deep learning and two-dimensional time-frequency codification
summary: The automated classification of cardiac arrhythmias in electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is critical for cardiovascular diagnosis. Several studies focus on the classification of ECG rhythms. However this task remains a challenge, as is often affected by significant class imbalances, long-term temporal dependencies and fine morphological features. Supervised deep learning methods have shown potential for signal classification due to high performance and scalability. This work presents a novel deep learning framework for multi-class arrhythmia classification based on a dual ResNet-18 architecture. The proposed method transforms ECG segments into two-dimensional time-frequency representations using Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) processed to extract spatial features and sequential temporal self-attention mechanism. Furthermore, to mitigate class imbalance Focal Loss objective function and weighted random sampler were integrated during optimization. Experimental validation using PhysioNet MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database demostrates effectiveness, achieving an overall classification accuracy of 97.39 % and Macro-F1 score of 0.954 across the four classes. These results confirm that the dual time-frequency codification with temporal attention works as a robust and reliable alternative for automated ECG signal classification.

AI.tldr: 基于双ResNet-18架构和时频编码的深度学习模型在MIT-BIH数据库上实现四类心律失常分类，总体准确率97.39%，Macro-F1为0.954。
AI.motivation: 心电图心律失常的自动分类对心血管诊断至关重要，但现有方法常受类别不平衡、长时程时间依赖性和细微形态特征影响，监督深度学习虽具潜力但仍有挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种基于双ResNet-18架构的深度学习框架，将ECG片段通过短时傅里叶变换和连续小波变换转换为二维时频表示，提取空间特征并引入时序自注意力机制；采用Focal Loss和加权随机采样器缓解类别不平衡；在PhysioNet MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上进行实验验证，评估四分类性能，主要终点为总体分类准确率和Macro-F1分数。
AI.result: 在MIT-BIH数据库的四类心律失常分类中，总体分类准确率达97.39%，Macro-F1分数为0.954；摘要未报告其他统计指标如95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 双时频编码结合时序注意力机制可作为自动ECG信号分类的稳健可靠替代方案，但研究仅基于单一公共数据库，临床适用性需进一步外部验证。

summary_zh: 心电图（ECG）信号中心律失常的自动分类对心血管诊断至关重要。多项研究聚焦于ECG节律的分类。然而，这一任务仍具挑战性，常受到显著类别不平衡、长期时间依赖性和细微形态特征的影响。监督式深度学习方法因高性能和可扩展性而在信号分类方面显示出潜力。本工作提出了一种基于双ResNet-18架构的新型深度学习框架，用于多类心律失常分类。所提方法利用短时傅里叶变换（STFT）和连续小波变换（CWT）将ECG片段转换为二维时频表示，并经过处理以提取空间特征和序列时间自注意力机制。此外，为缓解类别不平衡，在优化过程中整合了Focal Loss目标函数和加权随机采样器。使用PhysioNet MIT-BIH心律失常数据库进行的实验验证证明了有效性，在四个类别上实现了97.39%的总体分类准确率和0.954的宏F1分数。这些结果证实，双时频编码结合时间注意力可作为自动ECG信号分类的一种稳健可靠的替代方案。

title: A Rounding Error Dressed as Reform: The Implications of a Large Private Health Insurance Company's Prior Authorization Concession for the Electrophysiology Patient.
